sources.title: Bounded independent chat contract CPU verification
Exact byte IDs, positions and denominator calculation
sources.details: ASCII1=49,+43,=61,?63,2=50; +8 gives57,51,69,71,58. BOS/user/question5bytes/EOS/assistant/answer1byte/EOS gives1+1+5+1+1+1+1=11 tokens; a one-token shift gives10 positions. Assistant byte+EOS give2 active targets at positions8,9. V=256+8=264; constructed zero logits assign1/264 each, so 2 targets give2ln264 summed NLL; divide by2 to obtainln264. Index, token ID, original byte and active-target units are kept distinct.
